title: Cross-functional objective cascade and initiative mosaic
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Teams operate with locally optimized initiatives; company-level OKRs drift into misaligned workstreams and create duplicate effort. Goal: Create a repeatable "objective cascade" and visual "initiative mosaic" that translates company-level OKRs into clear, cross-team commitments, dependency lanes, and measurable outcomes for the upcoming quarter. This ticket scopes creation of the alignment artifact, a lightweight governance flow, and rollout guidance for PM/Eng/Design leads. The artifact must be actionable (owners, handoffs, milestones) and consumable in both Confluence and the Console (links and dashboards).
acceptance_criteria: A canonical objective cascade doc exists in Confluence with every company OKR mapped to 3–5 supporting initiatives and clear owners
An initiative mosaic (SVG/PNG and CSV) showing dependencies, owners, and change windows is produced and attached to the doc
A gating checklist and decision cadence (weekly triage + quarterly gate) is defined and agreed by cross-functional leads
A minimal dashboard prototype with the top 8 alignment signals (traffic light: green/amber/red) is published in the Console for stakeholders
Rollout notes, a 30/60/90 day adoption plan, and a training session schedule are created
success_metrics: By end of Q2, 90% of initiatives supporting company OKRs have explicit dependencies and an assigned owner
Reduction of cross-team duplicate work by 30% (tracked by tagged tickets) within one quarter
Stakeholder satisfaction score >= 4/5 in post-rollout survey
Time saved in weekly leadership syncs: reduce ad-hoc dependency discussion by 50%
rollout_plan: Week 1: Draft objective cascade and initial initiative roster; solicit feedback from Eng, Design, Security leads
Week 2: Run alignment workshop (2hr) to validate owners, handoffs, and dependency lanes; capture mosaics
Week 3: Produce artifact (Confluence + PNG + CSV) and prototype Console signals dashboard; release to stakeholders
Week 4: Host training for PMs and EMs; collect feedback and refine artifacts
Month 2: Monitor signals, run weekly triage, and adjust initiative boundaries ahead of quarterly gate
Month 3: Execute quarterly gate review and update next-cycle objective cascade
risks: Risk: Teams may treat cascade as directive rather than guiding artifact — mitigation: emphasize RACI and negotiation windows in workshop
Risk: Lack of instrumentation for signals — mitigation: scope minimal viable metrics and tag conventions
Risk: Overly granular initiatives create maintenance overhead — mitigation: cap child initiatives to 5 per OKR and require measurable KPI
Risk: Resource contention across Dedicated and Private launches — mitigation: surface capacity constraints into mosaic and escalate to CTO forum
